title: Lotus Breathy Vow
style: electronic, 96 BPM, whispered female duet, breathy lead vocals, vocoder harmonies, sidechained synth bass, octave bass melody, arpeggiated plucks, glassy lead synth, filtered pad swells, four-on-the-floor kick, syncopated percussion, gated reverb snare, ping-pong delay, wide stereo imaging, bittersweet uplift, nocturnal release
lyrics:
Full track outline / lyrics concept (Multilingual Duet v5.5)
(Below is a structured lyric‑style script you can paste into Suno. It’s under 5000 characters and designed to sound like a real song, even if you don’t sing every line perfectly.)

[Intro – Soft, whispered, multilingual]
In the lotus, the world begins,
kamal se jaga jalti hain…
From wind to water, from earth to sky,
un loto en el cielo, un loto en mí…

[Verse 1 – English / Hindi blends]
I was a shadow on the riverbank,
Till the lotus opened, pale and white.
Petals like prayers, soft and thin,
Roots in the mud, heart in the light.

कमल की जड़ों में गहरी रात,
पर फूल खिलता है सूरज की बात.
कहीं भी, किसी भी ज़बान में,
ये लोटस दिलों को धड़कन बनाए.

[Pre‑Chorus – Spanish / English]
En la sombra crece el loto,
Donde el agua calla,
I rise from the river,
With a language that knows no border.

[Chorus – English with Spanish echoes]
Oh, lotus in many tongues,
Every tongue that sings you,
Turns the night into a wing,
Turns the wound into a bloom.

Un loto levanta mi alma,
Un loto vuelve mi sombra gracia,
Lotus across oceans,
Lotus across silence.

[Verse 2 – French / English mix]
Dans le silence, un lotus respire,
Il n’a pas peur de la boue où il vit.
Like a name whispered near the fire,
Arvind, Aravind, it almost fits.

Rising from the mud, rising from the deep,
Lotus in Hindi, lotus in Gaulish dreams,
In every temple, every street, every stream,
They call it love, they call it grace, they call it kamal, it seems.

[Bridge – almost chant‑like, Sanskrit/Hindi feel]
*Aravinda, aravinda, jala‑majā, jala‑majā,
Kamala‑kanta, kamala‑kanta, prakāśa‑sūrya‑nātha.*
Lotus of the waters, born from the dark,
Every language finds you—but you never break.

[Chorus – Reprise, higher emotion]
Oh, lotus in many tongues,
Every prayer that holds you,
Turns the wound into a wing,
Turns the fall into a dawn.

*Un loto en el río,
Ein Lotus im Wind,
Un lotus dans le ciel,
Ты, лотос, внутри мной…*

[Outro – Whispered, fading]
Lotus across oceans,
Lotus across wars,
Lotus across names,
Lotus without borders.

कमल कहीं भी खिलता है,
जहाँ भी दिल जलता है.
कहीं भी ज़बान गुनगुनाए,
वहीं लोटस बस जाए.

In the end, the lotus still sings,
In every tongue that whispers,
Ar‑vin‑d…
Lotus.
